text: oneil: "day_vol 1.32 fails C16." On my break test (C5, R3) effort at or above its own average is enough: 1.32 is not an upthrust. My objection is a different one: Friday closed mid-bar, so it was not a sign-of-strength (C12). That is why I wait rather than buy now. The test of the Creek at structure_shift_ref 291.4 is the location; the trigger is an hourly close above the bar high on volume >= 1.2x. A daily close under bar_low 291.01 / structure_shift_ref 291.4 ends it. Volume alone does not void a break that is holding above value.
